title: Require meaningful argument names at F# calls (preview)
goal: Require names on selected F# preview calls to prevent same-typed argument swaps.

selectionNotes: Preview; supply the attribute absent from RC2 BCL. Enforcement is caller-side F# only.

prerequisites: Use an F# net11.0 executable or library, .NET 11 SDK, FSharp.Core 11 and LangVersion=preview.
Compile supplied RequireNamedArguments.fs before the API; the RC2 BCL has no definition.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Use the .NET 11 SDK and its F# compiler for the declared target.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: This verified edition targets net11.0; the .NET 10 sample is a comparison, not an older-target catalogue route.

language.name: F#
language.reason: Preview is required for this compiler feature.

constraints: Experimental: enforcement depends on the calling F# compiler and preview mode; C# callers and runtime invocation are not restricted by this check.

Preserve parameter names when evolving the API because named callers depend on them. The sample supplies the exact namespace/name and method/constructor AttributeUsage; it is not a shipped framework definition.
